stories.title: Simon Harmer credits Proteas appetite for the fight ahead of Australia rematch in Durban
stories.summary: Simon Harmer emphasizes the Proteas' strong desire to compete, particularly as they prepare for a series against Australia in Durban. He highlights the team's collective resilience and their ability to excel when faced with challenges.
stories.angle: This showcases the Proteas' admirable team spirit and determination.
